Interface InteractiveLoginProvider

All Superinterfaces:
AutoCloseable, Extension
All Known Implementing Classes:
OidcLoginProvider
public interface InteractiveLoginProvider extends Extension
Browser login protocol adapter. The core owns state, PKCE secrets and local account mapping. Implementations must be thread-safe and must not return an identity until protocol validation succeeds.
